name: Italy: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned), protocol number, sponsor, version and date match the protocol, CTIS and the rest of the package.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or another party are left empty, not invented.
No drafting instruction remains; tracked changes, comments and hidden text removed.
Language is Italian or English (insurance certificate: Italian); no signature unless this document's signature rule requires one (N1: institution's legal representative or delegate; O1: insurer).
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; the visible version matches the uploaded filename.

IT-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex recruitment and informed-consent procedure template version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026, including additional Member States and Article 11 completion); evidence of the version retained.
The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says N/A.

National sections contain the Italian additions in national_fields (CCNCE ongoing-communication process, Italian language and cultural mediator, separate privacy notice, electronic consent only with ethics approval, nationally valid forms; representative types and fiduciario rule; parental signature routes; at least one impartial witness; Article 35 safeguards).
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match the recruitment material (IT-K2) and the protocol, without contradictory duplication of the protocol.
No participant, investigator or sponsor signature on the upload.

IT-S1.check: New and archive sample sections match the protocol and sample plan; at least one is completed.

Section 5 describes compliance with Italian national law and custodianship; coding, storage location, access, transfer, retention and destruction match the participant documents, the privacy notice and IT-R1.
Protocol-required analysis is distinguished from optional future research; future use outside the protocol is answered consistently with the separate Italian sample consent (secondary-use document).
The model used is the latest applicable EU or Italian model listed by AIFA (decision recorded in DECISIONS.md).

IT-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and site on the current EU principal-investigator CV template (mandatory in Italy); not CVs for the whole site team.
Shows education, clinical-trial experience, relevant therapeutic expertise and GCP training; current; all required fields completed.
No signature requirement added beyond the EU form; filename identifies investigator and site without unnecessary personal data.

IT-M2-DOI.check: On the current CCNCE national declaration-of-interests model (version 4, 21 April 2024, or a newer AIFA version), Italian or English as provided by AIFA, not the EU form.
One declaration per principal investigator and site, completed and dated by the investigator; financial, institutional and other interests answered by the investigator.
Consistent with the CV, site name and CTIS site record; no coordinating centre invented to satisfy a legacy label.

IT-N1.check: One form per trial site on the current EU site-suitability template (mandatory in Italy); facilities, equipment, staffing, patient population, pharmacy, laboratories and other resources needed for the protocol described.
Statements are specific to this protocol and mark site capabilities for the site to confirm; site fields left empty for the site.

Signed at submission by the institution's legal representative or authorised delegate with PAdES or an equivalent accepted digital signature; delegation existed before signature and is retained, not uploaded.

External facilities performing part of the investigational treatment are treated as trial sites with their own form and local principal investigator; facilities performing only specific examinations are not listed as sites; private facilities meet the Ministerial Decree of 19 March 1998; contract in place and insurance covers the external activities.

IT-O1.check: Study-specific certificate satisfying the Ministerial Decree of 14 July 2009 (updated 16 December 2014), in Italian and signed by the insurer.

Covers the sponsor's and investigators' civil liability for trial-related injury for the whole trial; insured parties, protocol identifier, sites or territorial scope, policy dates, limits, exclusions and post-trial claim period checked against the study.
Extended post-trial period where the decree requires it for minors or certain advanced treatments.
Policy terms included when needed to demonstrate the required cover; insurer, policy number and claim route match every participant document.

IT-P1.check: Submitted on the current CCNCE national reimbursement and allowance model, not the interim EU compensation form.
Discloses all participant payments, reimbursements and documented loss-of-income arrangements with amounts, eligible costs, payment method, timing and the party administering payment.

Reimbursement of actual, documented trial-related costs; no promotional language; current Italian rules for vulnerable participants and healthy volunteers applied; no payment category taken over from another country's materials.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.

IT-P2.check: Contractual information on the national clinical-trial agreement version 3 (commercial 28 January 2026 as the minimum model; non-commercial 22 July 2026); the version matching trial.commercial.
Financial arrangements consistent with IT-P1 and the participant documents; execution with the contracting parties' signatures planned before site activation.

IT-R1.check: Covers lawful processing, security, confidentiality, data-subject information, rights, transfers, retention and the handling of coded data.
The national-statement field is answered as not applicable (no separate national form or statement for Italy); sponsor details match the CTIS application.
Aligned with the separate Italian privacy notice (IT-PRIVACY), the protocol, data-management plan, contracts and vendor flows; both documents are in the package.
